The '''Rishi moon''', also known simply as '''Rishi''', was a natural satellite of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].

==Topography==
[[File:Rishi_moon.png|thumb|left|200px|The listening post.]]
For half the year, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was very cold, necessitating the use of [[Tibanna/Legends|Liquid Tibanna]] and similar substances to heat any inhabited areas. The moon was also covered with craters, in which lived the large predatory [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eels]].<ref name="R" /> [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray]] were also native to the moon.<ref name="R" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the moon was the site of [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]. The listening post was [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his forces during the war to avoid arousing suspicion and sneak past the perimeter undetected in an attempt to attack the nearby planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], home of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The station was destroyed by [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] when he sacrificed himself to set off a bomb inside the base, terminating the "All-Clear" signal and therefore alerting the Republic to the Separatist [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attack]] on Kamino.<ref name="R" />
